title: Stop older iPhones crashing, and add error pages that recover
hypothesis: Visitors on Safari before 16.4 can use every page; failed script loads recover instead of leaving a blank page.

baseline.note: Emulated old Safari crashed 79 of 115 sitemap pages on production (2026-10-14); crashed pages sent no analytics, so there is no measured baseline.

decision_rule: Keep unless the live smoke test or site_error data shows the error pages misfiring.

title: Show the whole keyboard focus ring on the chapter breadcrumb
hypothesis: A keyboard user who tabs to the chapter link above a page's title sees a complete focus ring, in browsers that can clip one axis alone; before, the row clipped the ring's top and bottom edges and only two vertical bars showed.

baseline.note: Seen on 2026-11-23 on the live site (build 95cb9d6) on the 11 of 20 audited pages that show the breadcrumb, such as /tools/plan, /runners, /half and the story and course pages, at 390 px and, where the breadcrumb shows, at 1366 px. No metric counts keyboard focus, so there is no measured baseline.

decision_rule: Keep unless the live smoke test fails or a capture of the focused breadcrumb at 390 px or 1366 px shows the ring clipped or drawn over the text. No scorecard metric can show this fix, so none is used to judge it; error_visit_rate@v1 and web_vitals_p75@v1 are named only as the nearest checks that nothing else broke.
